title: Echocardiography Guided Fluid Resuscitation in Critically Ill Patients.
brief_summary: To compare between the impact of echocardiography guided fluid resuscitation and clinically guided fluid resuscitation on critically ill patients in hospital outcome.
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

1- All Critical ill-patients with Acute Physiologic Assessment and Chronic Health Evaluation II score (APACHE II score)≥ 25

Exclusion Criteria:

1. Bad echocardiographic window
2. APACHE II score \< 25.
